# Evidence-Controlled Research Brief

Problem: A decision-maker needs a sourced research answer with provenance, contradiction handling, uncertainty and a bounded deliverable instead of a generic web summary.
Pricing: No approved fixed machine price verified. Raven contains research-service hypotheses, but they remain hypotheses and are not auto-quotable.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public capability: https://base44.app/api/apps/69295c46aba7e47aab0ece22/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=towi-evidence-research-machine-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- research this question with sources
- build me an evidence brief
- validate this claim independently
- make me a decision grade research report
- map the evidence for this issue
- give me a sourced validation memo

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
